rules.new_licensee_rule: Technicians registered in their year of graduation need no CE for the next renewal.
rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses presented or approved by AVMA, AAHA, NCVMA, USDA-APHIS, AAVSB RACE, or academies/schools/colleges of veterinary medicine; other courses with prior Board approval
rules.audit_note: Keep a file of course content for the three most recent renewal periods.
rules.notes: Registered veterinary technicians: 12 hours per two-calendar-year registration period; max 6 hours self-study, prerecorded or non-interactive online. Proposed amendment (hearing 10/7/2026, proposed effective 1/1/2027) would add 1 hour of opioid training — not yet in force.
